gen-gf-bellota-gf-rethink-sans: Quirky and confident, Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine. Rethink Sans is the friendly counterweight, keeping its openings generous at every weight, and that shared tidy line is what ties them.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-roboto-flex: Bellota moves like a drafting pen, steady and drawn.  Its s flings its ends wide, while Roboto Flex answers with a roomy gap between the ends of its c, modern and easygoing.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-rosario: Rosario is a plain sans whose c ends never curl inward, so its text feels open and approachable. And Bellota, tracing each letter with a constant-weight line, gives the heading a more singular, hand-drawn voice.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-sansation: Sansation reads smooth and approachable, with no ink pooling where its curves turn inward. But Bellota is the one to enlarge for a few words, where the far-flung ends of its s and its pen-steady line stand out.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-sarabun: Bellota's s throws its ends far from the spine, and its letters look thin without ever having a thinner part. Sarabun does the opposite job, offering a wide channel into every bowl so the sans-serif text stays clear and friendly.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-sarala: Distinctive in the heading and approachable below, this pairing starts with Bellota's neon-tube strokes and wandering s. Sarala sits underneath with distinct gaps in c, e and s.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Bellota has a flat, stencil-cut feel, since every stroke keeps a single weight and the s ends drift far out. And Sawarabi Gothic backs it with open jaws on each curve, a quiet sans that lets the heading stand out.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-shanti: Bellota's single track width, like a neon sign tube, gives every letter a glowing, drawn look. Shanti takes the other job, a plain sans with a generous entry into the e's eye that keeps the text easy going.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-shippori-antique: Shippori Antique reads modern and open, its monoweight skeleton holding bowls tipped toward you like a ladle. But Bellota brings the pair's real character, with an s whose ends hang far from the spine.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-shippori-antique-b1: Stencil-brush lines, wide-swung s. Bellota is the showpiece here, built for heading size, while Shippori Antique B1 is the sans-serif that lets daylight through every curve and keeps the text modern and plain.
